company.name: Clara Labs
company.shortDescription: Clara Labs provides scheduling service that coordinates when, where, and how candidates meet with recruiters and interviewers.
company.description: Clara did inventive work on human-in-the-loop NLP systems and built one of the earliest well-loved conversational UX products. In 2019, the business was acquired by TopFunnel (https://topfunnel.co) who continues to operate the service, and Twitter acquired the R&D talent and some IP to apply towards content moderation.

productsAndServices.description: An email-based virtual assistant that manages meeting scheduling by coordinating times, sending invites, and handling follow-ups automatically.
